title: Demonstration opposing far-right politics at Brussels Central Station

actual_occurrence.summary: BRUZZ reports about 200 people met at Brussels Central Station on 3 October.

start_date.summary: Article dated 3 October identifies a Saturday action that day.

demand.summary: Action opposed far-right politics, with a reference to a Greek court case and domestic Vlaams Belang; one union leader said government should have banned Vlaams Belang’s earlier event.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: About 200 in a single static gathering.

notes: State targeting is unresolved: the event predominantly protested far-right parties/ideas, but one quoted participant demanded government prohibition of Vlaams Belang’s earlier event. It also references a Greek trial, which is not a domestic-state demand. Keep pending rather than treating opposition to a party as automatically anti-state. ccode 211 provisional.
